_comment: Copy to config.json (start.ps1 does this on first run) and edit. Keys starting with _ are comments. Coordinates are physical pixels. Restart after changes; notes_files, pacing_file and notes_rules reload live (reload the panel with F5).
_hotkeys: Global hotkeys. Format: Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win + key (F1-F24, A-Z, 0-9, PgUp, PgDn, Home, End, ...). Empty string disables one. If another program owns a key, the panel shows a warning: pick another here.
_displays: Device names such as \\.\DISPLAY1. Empty: source = primary display, target = first other display.
_source: Window titles to auto-select at start, tried in order. Empty list: the foreground window at start; press the pick hotkey (F7) any time.
_preview: Panel preview of what the audience sees: a small JPEG of the projector every preview_interval_sec seconds (0 = off), saved only in logs/ (gitignored, deleted when the mirror stops), never uploaded.
_font_path: Optional .ttf/.ttc for the blank screen, e.g. C:\Windows\Fonts\msjh.ttc for Chinese text. Empty: a system UI font.
_panel_runtime: windows = run panel_server.py with the Windows venv Python (default). wsl = run it inside WSL (wsl_distro empty = default distro).
_panel_browser: Chrome or Edge used for the panel --app window. Empty: auto-detect.
_content: content_root is the folder for notes, pacing and the AI helper. Relative paths are relative to this repo.
_profiles: notes_files, pacing_file / pacing_notes and notes_rules below form the first profile, named profile_name. profiles (further down) adds more; the panel switches them together. Start with one: --profile NAME, the PRESENTER_PROFILE variable or profile here (empty = the first).
_pacing_notes: Instead of pacing_file: a notes file whose ## sections say 'Suggested time: ~N min' (or 建議時間：約 N 分鐘) becomes the pacing.
_notes_follow_doc: Notes file the auto-follow jumps in. Empty: the file you are viewing. A rule may also set its own "doc".
_cdp_url: Optional, enables url_contains rules (full URL including #hash). Needs the projected browser started with --remote-debugging-port=9222. Loopback only. Read SECURITY notes in README first. Empty: title rules only.
_notes_rules: Checked top to bottom; first match wins. title_contains = tab title; url_contains = URL incl. #hash (needs cdp_url). section_heading_contains matches a ## heading (or the # title).
_profile_auto_switch: When the projected page matches a rule of another profile, auto-follow switches to that profile (with a notice).
_ai_helper: Optional read-only assistant backed by the Claude Code CLI (must be installed and signed in). Off by default. workdir is relative to content_root.
